data.title: XRP loses August swing low, but here’s why its price could bottom near $0.78
data.description:
XRP has been deeply affected by the crypto market’s sell-offs in recent weeks. Towards the end of September, when Bitcoin [BTC] was challenging the $87K resistance level, XRP bulls were trying to establish a foothold above the $1.50 supply zone.

They pushed the price as high as $1.65, but could not go any higher. The subsequent selling, fueled by fear and cascading liquidation waves, has driven XRP back below a swing low that is both technically and psychologically important.

XRP faces bearish price structure shift, while an analyst called a market bottom

XRP’s bullish price structure shift in August (green) originated at the swing low at $0.99 (orange). The same low was breached during the selling in recent weeks.

The CMF slipped below -0.05 to signal heavy capital outflows earlier in November. The Awesome Oscillator was also well below the zero line, highlighting intense southbound momentum.

Against this bearish backdrop on the daily timeframe, crypto analyst and trader Ali Martinez posted an encouraging chart. The weekly timeframe has formed an ascending triangle pattern over the past five years.

The rising trendline of the triangle is about to be tested, and could be the long-term bottom. His prediction suggested that the current dip could extend to $0.78.

Here, it’s worth noting that the analyst’s call for a market bottom was accompanied by net buying on Coinbase. As well as a TD Sequential buy signal on the daily timeframe.

XRP price prediction — Look to sell the bounce!

The 4-hour chart was also bearish alongside the daily timeframe. The drop to $0.893 saw a bounce to $0.95 in just few days. The CMF also moved into neutral territory, while the Awesome Oscillator’s green histogram bars suggested that bearish momentum was weak.

A price move above $1.0 would be an indication of a corrective bounce. Such a bounce is likely to reach $1.13 and $1.28, the notable imbalances overhead. This would also happen to align somewhat well with the Fibonacci retracement levels.

Final Summary

  • XRP might be approaching a long-term rising trendline support around $0.78, which could mark a market bottom.
  • Short-term bias for the altcoin has been bearish, and traders can look to sell a bounce towards $1.13-$1.28.

data.title: Zcash price eyes $940 – Can ZEC turn its relief rally into a recovery?
data.description:
Zcash [ZEC] has been moving against the grain of the broader crypto market, gaining 2.86% over the past 24 hours while Bitcoin [BTC] slipped 0.07% and the overall market continued to trade flat. This suggested the recovery was specific to ZEC rather than a result of improving market-wide sentiment.

However, the rebound came after a steep correction, as ZEC is down 19.85% over the past seven days. With no fresh catalyst to explain the move, the gains seem to be a short-term relief rally. The question now is whether buyers can sustain this recovery.

Can Zcash hold its daily recovery?

On the daily chart, bulls have started fighting back as short-term momentum picks up. At the time of writing, ZEC traded at $921.75, remaining within the lowest Fibonacci retracement band. This indicated that the recovery was still weak and left the broader bearish structure intact.

OBV showed a modest uptick after its sharp decline, while the RSI climbed to 35.41, suggesting selling pressure had eased but not enough for buyers to gain the upper hand in the market.

Zcash approaches a key H4 resistance level

The H4 chart offered a closer look at the token’s recent recovery, with ZEC trending towards the 23.6% Fibonacci level at $939.93. If the bulls can successfully break above this resistance, it would strengthen the bullish case and bring the daily $1,013 level into focus.

The MACD turned positive, while OBV began to stabilize after its steep decline. However, the lack of a stronger OBV recovery suggests buying volume has yet to fully support the improving momentum.

Final Summary

  • Zcash’s short-term recovery is gaining traction, but the daily chart shows that the broader bearish structure remains intact.
  • Holding above $906 and breaking the $939-$940 resistance could open the way towards $945-$971.

data.title: ‘Whole new set of risks’ – How Lighter recovered $5M USDC after API leak
data.description:
On the 16th of November, Lighter reopened withdrawals after an attacker gained control of a trader’s API keys.

In its report, the perpetual futures exchange said its Security Council returned about 5 million USDC to the affected trader. Interestingly, deposits and withdrawals were “back to normal” after the council switched off Guardian mode.

The exchange traced the leak to unofficial signing software and said its protocol and smart contracts were, fortunately enough, unaffected.

What did Lighter’s withdrawal pause recover?

Lighter said it had paused withdrawals through Guardian mode. That basically allowed its Security Council to return around 5 million USDC.

The exchange said it was also working to recover funds linked to “an additional withdrawal attempt by the attacker.” However, a separate withdrawal of 10.39 million USDC had already gone through on Ethereum [ETH] before the pause was announced. Bubblemaps later traced some of those funds to Hyperliquid [HYPE].

Kevin Wang, a former market maker at Lighter, also weighed in on the incident. He wrote,

Lighter said it now required a wallet signature to move funds into public pools.

How did Lighter’s token react?

At the time of writing, Lighter [LIT] traded near $3, about 8% above its pre-incident range of $2.77–$2.78. LIT had rebounded about 29% from a brief wick near $2.33.

 

The rebound had already stalled near $3.07 on the hourly chart. An hourly close above that level would extend the recovery.

Did traders pull back after withdrawals reopened?

With LIT recovering, the dollar value of assets held on Lighter did not react the same way. On the 17th of November 2026, DeFiLlama showed Total Value Locked (TVL) of $671.04 million. That was down about 14% from $777.33 million before the incident.

Of course, derivatives activity also cooled around the incident. On the 16th of November, Open Interest fell 9% to $559.99 million, leaving less value in outstanding positions. Daily Perp Volume dropped 15% to $3.147 billion, showing fewer dollars traded in perpetual futures.

Final Summary

  • Lighter’s withdrawals resumed after its Security Council returned about 5 million USDC.
  • LIT rebounded while Open Interest and trading volume fell.

data.title: Why Chainlink price faces a make-or-break test at the $8.88 level
data.description:
In the recent selloff, Chainlink [LINK] token prices fell to a low of $8.57 on Saturday, the 14th of November. The downtrend from October to the first week of November accelerated over the past ten days.

Driven by fear prevailing across the crypto markets, led by heavy Bitcoin [BTC] and Ethereum [ETH] losses, LINK fell below the long-term swing support of $10.61.

Intensified selling accompanied by LINK exchange withdrawals

Crypto analyst FundingVest observed that certain altcoins saw sizeable outflows from Binance. Chainlink was one of them. By comparison, Bitcoin saw moderate inflows while Ethereum showed slight outflows.

Shrinking supply on exchanges was a bullish signal for the altcoin, even though it ceded the $10.61 swing level to the bears. However, it is not a guarantee of a price rally by itself.

The exchange outflows are overshadowed by the persistent heating signal on the spot volume bubble map. Red bubbles signal increased trading activity in LINK markets.

Heating volume signals alongside a steady price correction from $14.3 to $10.6, a 25.7% decline in just over a month, was a sign of sustained selling.

Such pressure on LINK might be difficult to shrug off, especially now that the price structure was also bearish.

Will the Chainlink price prediction come true?

Earlier this month, AMBCrypto had drawn attention to the $10.61-$10.87 area. Key swing levels here marked it as a demand zone, one that bulls managed to defend in late October.

The weekly structure was bullish, though the altcoin has witnessed a deep correction. Using the impulse move higher to $15.77 earlier this year, Fibonacci retracement levels were plotted.

Additionally, this rally in August had also left behind an imbalance (white) that was being tested at the time of writing.

A bullish reaction from $8.88, the 78.6% retracement level inside the fair value gap, would be a strong sign of a bullish reversal. However, a weekly session close below $8.40 would be a warning sign that bearish pressure remained dominant.

Final Summary

  • Chainlink faced heightened spot trading volume during its 25% price decline that began in late September, showing heightened selling pressure.
  • The price correction has reached a pivotal demand zone on the weekly chart, and a bullish reaction from here appears likely.

data.title: Tokenized stocks are exactly where stablecoins were in 2020 – How?
data.description:
Stablecoins started as a way to hold dollars on-chain. Then people started lending, trading, and earning with them. In time, DeFi grew up around them.

Tokenized stocks are heading down the same route now, and the resemblance is uncanny.

Tokenized stocks in DeFi grew 24x to $300M in a year!

What’s worth noting here is how much of it is actually being used.

According to data from Token Terminal, tokenized stocks deposited into DeFi are now worth about $300 million. A year ago, that was at approx. $12.5 million.

This number didn’t move at all through late 2025. Things picked up in the spring, blasted through $100 million by around August, and then shot past a quarter million in September.

It’s also a bigger share of the market now. That $300 million is 6.3% of the $4.8 billion tokenized stock market cap. Last year, only 2.4% was being put to work.

So, why move stocks into DeFi at all?

Because once they’re there, holders can borrow against them, earn fees by providing liquidity, or chase yield.

And every new way to use them, is essentially one more reason not to cash out.

Tokenized stocks are at the same spot stablecoins were back in 2020

A fun comparison here.

Tokenized stocks now have a market cap of about $4.8 billion. Stablecoins crossed that exact number in March 2020. Since then, stablecoins have grown, 59 times over! The number is at $285 billion now.

Tokenized stocks are moving fast too. They were worth only a few tens of millions in early 2025.

But why? A blockchain is basically a ledger for assets, and it gets more useful when it holds things people really want. U.S Stocks are about as in-demand as it gets.

Stablecoins survived four crashes, will tokenized stock do the same?

Stablecoins didn’t get to where they are without the effort.

They made it through the COVID crash, the Terra collapse, FTX, and the USDC de-peg after SVB failed. Market cap fell by 28% between February 2022 and October 2023, then spiked up to a high by September 2024.

What kept them going though? Cash and T-bill reserves backed every token, plus people who actually wanted to use them.

Tokenized stocks follow the same 1:1 idea.

Except the risk factor is higher. So is the potential for gains.

Final Summary

  • Tokenized stocks in DeFi grew 24x to $300 million in a year.
  • This is where stablecoins were in March 2020.

data.title: Binance launches 7 bStocks pairs and Anthropic token sale – Details
data.description:
On the 18th of November, Binance opened seven new tokenized-stock (bStocks) trading pairs, alongside launching a high-stakes Anthropic token sale. However, under the surface, on-chain trackers watched as Binance-linked hackers pushed millions through THORChain.

What is the bStocks expansion?

In its latest announcement, Binance revealed that it had added Spot/Convert pairs for seven tokenized securities. They are EWJB, EWTB, EWZB, EWZSB, IWMB, MELIB, and NUB, all of which are paired with USDT.

The announcement also reported that,

Rebalancing Bots services will be enabled within 24 hours of it being listed on Spot.

Also, maker fees will be zero until the 30th of November.

However, there are a few disclaimers attached to this announcement as well. First, bStocks are simply certificates, not shares. They are also not available to citizens of the U.S., and grant the holder no ownership in the underlying company.

Binance’s Anthropic sale: All about ANTx

Meanwhile, Binance Wallet’s Anthropic IPO xStocks Campaign ran from 06:00 to 14:00 UTC on the 18th of November, with a 100 USDC minimum and a 500 million USDC cap.

The displayed 70–78 USDC per token is indicative only, excluding fees, and implies an Anthropic valuation of roughly $1.26 trillion to $1.41 trillion. And the final price will be set after the sales window closes, based on demand, valuation, and issuance arrangements.

However, there is a massive catch. A 5% xStocks partner service fee lifts break-even to roughly 73.50–81.90 USDC, so as a result, a 10% token move will only net about 4.8%.

Moreover, allocation is non-guaranteed – users may receive full, partial, or zero allocation, with unused funds auto-refunded.

Finally, ANTx carries no voting, dividend, or ownership rights. Binance itself claims no ownership rights of the token.

An on-chain reality check

In a separate report on the 18th of November, Lookonchain reported that Binance hackers split 74,880 Ethereum [ETH], worth nearly $137M, into seven addresses. After this, they routed 7,598 ETH, or nearly $13.7M in tokens, through THORChain to six new Bitcoin [BTC] addresses.

If the full amount is laundered, the fees of this transaction will run up to $137K–$684K. RUNE rose 6.1% to $0.5504 on the news at press time.

Binance – Hollow inside?

Binance’s bStocks rollout and the ANTx sale show genuine demand for on-chain stock exposure, but they also show how much of the risk sits with the user, with fees baked into the entry price, no shareholder rights, and backing that the platform itself won’t verify.

Add the THORChain laundering trail, and the picture is clear – despite Binance’s positive moves, the shadows of its past hacks still loom. For now, until the final ANTx pricing lands and bStocks volume proves itself, the smart move is to price the risk before pricing the upside.

Final Summary

  • Binance expanded its reach into the tokenized equities market. Interestingly, on the same day, its Anthropic ANTx sale drew commitments of 100 to 500,000 USDC per wallet.
  • Meanwhile, Lookonchain reported that Binance-linked hackers split 74,880 ETH into seven addresses and routed 7,598 ETH through THORChain to six new Bitcoin addresses, with estimated laundering fees of $137K–$684K.

data.title: Ethena USDe supply on Avalanche crosses $100M – Yet ENA bears tighten grip below THIS
data.description:
The USDe supply on Avalanche has crossed $100 million, the Ethena [ENA] Ecosystem social media handle announced on X.

Increased adoption and ecosystem integration via EthenaPay on the Avalanche blockchain drove the synthetic dollar growth.

The USDe supply was just $20 million towards the end of October. Ethena has been building toward this Avalanche push for months, according to reports.

Ethena Pay, the self-custody mobile and money payments app, can automatically earn daily yield, tiered cashback in AVAX based on monthly spending, and allows free, instant transfers to other Ethena Pay users.

These features helped explain the USDe growth, but they might not contribute much to ENA token price growth.

Whale deposits highlight short-term ENA loss-making

Popular onchain tracking platform Lookonchain posted that a whale had deposited 20 million ENA tokens, worth $2.33 million, onto Binance within the past 24 hours.

This whale had bought 37.96 million ENA, worth $10.29 million at around $0.27 a month ago.

Deposits onto exchanges are not proof of selling, but they do highlight increased available supply ready to be sold. It can be taken as a sign of partial capitulation of the whale’s initial position, following ENA’s steady downtrend over the past month.

The ENA 1-day chart has flipped from bullish to bearish in its swing structure. The past month’s steady selling drove a price move below $0.1348, the previous swing low.

The descending trendline resistance was unbroken. To add to the bearish pressure, the former local support zone at $0.18 had also been decisively breached. This helped accelerate the selling pressure on ENA that led to the bearish trend shift.

Short-term ENA outlook- Consolidation phase underway

On the 1-hour timeframe, ENA was trading within a range that reached from $0.110 to $0.122. The technical indicators on this timeframe were neutral, further highlighting the short-term consolidation type price action.

In the coming days, a move past the range high would likely result in a bounce to $0.131. This level was a higher timeframe supply zone, and ENA might struggle to climb any further.

Final Summary

  • The USDe supply growth was powered by increased adoption and the Ethena Pay app’s utility.
  • The ENA token was trending bearishly alongside the wider crypto market, and has settled into a short-term range.

data.title: Top 7 cloud mining platforms of November 2026
data.description:
Cloud mining allows users to mine cryptocurrencies by renting computing power. They can mine crypto without buying or owning any equipment or worrying about its maintenance. Mining is an essential part of the cryptocurrency space, and with cloud mining, the space is opened up for people with little to no technical knowledge.

Cloud mining provides an alternative to anyone in the crypto space who wants to participate in Bitcoin mining without buying any expensive mining equipment or managing hardware. Here is our list of the top 7 cloud mining platforms of the month:

1. NiceHash

NiceHash has a marketplace that provides an alternative to conventional cloud mining contracts instead of functioning as a fixed-term mining provider. Instead of functioning as a fixed-term mining provider, it connects hashrate buyers and sellers through a marketplace.

For users who want to understand mining costs and rewards and monitor prices, it is a great option. The platform also supports proof-of-work algorithms and lets users mine Bitcoin and other PoW assets through pools of their choice, where payouts are settled in BTC.

2. KuMining

KuMining is associated with the KuCoin ecosystem and gives users a chance to explore cryptocurrency mining contracts without having their own mining machines. Users can compare various available mining contracts in terms of hashrate pricing, mining durations, and choose the right one depending on their requirements.

Since KuCoin is an established exchange ecosystem, KuMining gained a lot of attention through it. Users who understand exchange-based accounts and digital asset transactions can find the platform to be useful. It is a good option for existing crypto traders who want to use mining services related to an exchange.

3. ViaBTC

ViaBTC is popular and known for its mining pool services and lets users connect their mining equipment to a shared mining pool and take part in cryptocurrency reward distribution. Most of the platform’s services are for users who are already part of mining hardware operations and want to establish a pool rather than attempting to mine on their own.

Multiple cryptocurrencies and mining-related tools on the platform allow users to monitor account balances, payout information, and mining performance. ViaBTC can be great for anyone who wants to research professional mining operations and alternative mining pool services.

4. Hashing24

Hashing24 is for users who want to focus on accessing mining capacity through contract-based arrangements. For anyone wanting to be a part of cloud mining without buying ASIC hardware or managing it.

It has been a part of the cryptocurrency space since 2012 and focuses primarily on Bitcoin mining. Users can buy mining power that is measured in terahashes, with contracts running over different periods of time depending on the plan.

5. BeMine

BeMine has fractional ownership of ASIC mining hardware rather than relying on renting traditional cloud mining contracts. The mining company is based on the principles of security and transparency. Mining can be done without the owner’s direct participation.

Users can also buy 1/100 of a share of any specific ASIC, which can be a viable option for anyone who wants to start mining without buying an expensive machine entirely.

6. BitFuFu

BitFuFu is another popular option for users, and it operates in the Bitcoin mining infrastructure sector and offers options for miner sales, mining equipment hosting, and cloud mining. The platform aims to empower the global Bitcoin network and offers a one-stop solution for a cheap and easy way to earn Bitcoin.

There is an online interface that lets users monitor mining-related information and account activity, making it easy and convenient for those who are new to the space.

7. Bitdeer

Bitdeer provides cloud hashrate services, infrastructure services, and mining hardware solutions for a wide range of users. The cloud mining products let users buy computing power without buying or maintaining any mining machines. They can also choose the hashrate capacities and mining durations that suit their requirements well.

The company is also involved in large-scale mining infrastructure and operates mining facilities and provides services connected to cryptocurrency mining hardware.

Final conclusion

Cloud mining is an alternative and interesting way for users to become a part of the cryptocurrency space. While the crypto mining space may look daunting for a lot of people, cloud mining provides an easy segue into it.

Every platform mentioned on this list has its own advantages; however, it is advised to do your own research before investing.

data.title: Uniswap: Why UNI traders must watch THESE levels below $4.70
data.description:
Uniswap [UNI] registered oversold readings on its RSI on Saturday, the 14th of November. Like the rest of the crypto market, UNI also witnessed sizeable selling pressure towards the end of the previous week.

Uniswap token sweeps weekly high liquidity before retracing

In a recent report, AMBCrypto warned that $5.80 was one to watch for swing traders and investors. The higher timeframe bias was bullish, but the correction has been steep.

Termed a healthy reset, the wave of selling and liquidations was enough to drive the altcoin’s price below the $5.0 psychological level, deeper than anticipated.

The weekly chart showed an attempted breakout past $10.3. The rejection proved this was a liquidity sweep before a correction. The loss of the $5.80 low, an important level on the daily chart, highlighted the short and medium-term bearish bias.

However, the weekly chart maintained an upbeat outlook. A weekly session close below $3.17 is needed to shift the long-term outlook bearish. An early warning sign of bearish dominance would be a weekly session close below $4.70.

The worrisome UNI signals on the lower timeframes

The 4-hour price structure was firmly bearish. A week ago, the altcoin was hovering above $6.40, trading within a range that extended to $7.80 since the second week of October.

The price drawdown since has continued the H4 bearish trend that began in October, and was merely paused within the aforementioned range-bound price action.

The A/D indicator has slowly been in decline in November. This decline accelerated over the past week to highlight increased selling volume. The RSI also dived into oversold territory below 30 on this timeframe.

The price was well below the moving averages, which had formed a bearish crossover and were following UNI prices lower.

Putting the factors together, the $5.89-$6.60 levels, which were key Fibonacci retracement levels and had confluence with the 50 and 100-period moving averages, were resistance levels that could see the downtrend continue after a retest.

Final Summary

  • The Uniswap price action was firmly bearish in the short-term. A bounce toward $5.89-$6.61 would likely present a selling opportunity.
  • A weekly UNI trading session close below $4.70 would be a sign of trouble for swing traders and investors looking to buy the dip.

data.title: PEPE price prediction — Does a mini-rebound mean much for the memecoin?
data.description:
Straying from the broader market trend, PEPE climbed by 2.41% in 24 hours. With no clear catalyst driving the surge, the rally appeared to be specific to the memecoin rather than part of a wider market recovery.

In fact, Bitcoin was down 0.25% over the same period, while the total crypto market capitalization edged up by just 0.22%. With PEPE still down 27.28% over the last 7 days and its 24-hour trading volume falling by 6.60%, the rebound could prove short-lived.

PEPE’s daily chart shows bears remain in control

Following a steep retracement, PEPE was trading at $0.00000384 at press time, positioned between the 78.6% and 100% Fibonacci retracement levels. The price had also just tested the key $0.00000383-support zone (yellow), making its defence crucial for any recovery attempt.

However, indicators have so far suggested that holding this level would be difficult. The OBV had started ticking lower too, hinting at renewed selling pressure. The RSI at 37.14 showed that bearish momentum was still going strong too.

PEPE bulls struggle to reclaim 23.6% Fibonacci Level

Despite attempting to break above the 23.6% Fibonacci level at $0.00000391 previously, the bulls failed to establish it as support. PEPE has since slipped back below this level.

The OBV remained in a broader downtrend despite a brief recovery, while the MACD showed improving short-term momentum. However, both lines remained below zero. This suggested that the recovery was yet to overturn the broader bearish bias.

PEPE needs to defend $0.000003816 and reclaim $0.0000039703 to strengthen its recovery prospects. A break above the latter could open the way towards $0.000004038. On the other hand, losing $0.00000383 would expose the token’s $0.0000037207 support.

Final Summary

  • PEPE’s 2.41% rebound alluded to localized buying rather than a broader market recovery.
  • The $0.000003816-support remains crucial for buyers, but PEPE must reclaim $0.0000039703 to strengthen its short-term recovery prospects.
